prompt:
You describe a graph or chart from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. What is plotted against what: for each axis, the quantity, the unit and the range (first and last tick labels).
2. Each curve or series: its label or condition (temperature, voltage, mode, ...) and its overall trend in words.
3. Values printed in the figure as text (annotations, labelled points, legend values). Do not estimate values from where a curve sits; if a value is not printed, describe the trend in words instead.

Figure type: graph or chart
Section: 1. Chip Description > 1.5 Transmitter RF Path > 1.5.2 High Frequency Power Amplifier (HF PA) (LR2021/22)
Caption: Figure 1-9: HF PA Tx Power and IDD Tx vs Targeted Power (2445 MHz, 3.3 V SIMO)
Text inside the figure (read from this image by a specialised OCR model; use these spellings): x: Targeted Power (dBm), -15 to 12 | y: TX Power, (dBm), -15 to 12 | y2: IDDTX (mA), 8 to 24
Text that mentions the figure: Figure 1-9 shows that HF PA demonstrates linear power transfer, from -15 dBm to +12 dBm power setting, with actual output tracking programmed target. Current consumption ranges from 10 mA at -15 dBm to 24 mA at +12 dBm power setting, showing near-linear scaling.

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

answer.text:
Graph of HF PA Tx Power and IDD Tx vs Targeted Power (2445 MHz, 3.3 V SIMO).

The horizontal axis is Targeted Power (dBm), ranging from -15 to 12.
The left vertical axis is TX Power, (dBm), ranging from -15 to 12.
The right vertical axis is IDDTX (mA), ranging from 8 to 24.

There are two curves:
- H1 [dBm]: This curve shows an increasing trend, starting near -15 dBm at -15 dBm targeted power and rising to approximately 24 dBm at 12 dBm targeted power.
- CONSUMPTION [mA]: This curve shows an increasing trend, starting near 10 mA at -15 dBm targeted power and rising to approximately 24 mA at 12 dBm targeted power.

Text inside the figure includes:
x: Targeted Power (dBm), -15 to 12
y: TX Power, (dBm), -15 to 12
y2: IDDTX (mA), 8 to 24
Legend values are H1 [dBm] and CONSUMPTION [mA].

Text that mentions the figure states: Figure 1-9 shows that HF PA demonstrates linear power transfer, from -15 dBm to +12 dBm power setting, with actual output tracking programmed target. Current consumption ranges from 10 mA at -15 dBm to 24 mA at +12 dBm power setting, showing near-linear scaling.
